items.exampleEn: Our city has one of the leading hospitals in the country.
items.exampleZh: 我們市有一家國內領先的醫院。

items.exampleEn: This letter is too formal for a friend.
items.exampleZh: 這封信寫給朋友太正式了。

items.exampleEn: The two schools made a joint plan for the festival.
items.exampleZh: 兩所學校為節慶共同制定了一個計畫。

items.exampleEn: These are not special shoes; they are just ordinary ones.
items.exampleZh: 這不是什麼特別的鞋，只是普通的鞋子。

items.exampleEn: Here is some practical advice for your trip.
items.exampleZh: 這裡有一些對你的旅行實用的建議。

items.exampleEn: The mountain is visible from my window.
items.exampleZh: 從我的窗戶看得見那座山。

items.exampleEn: The team made a severe mistake in the last minute.
items.exampleZh: 球隊在最後一分鐘犯了一個嚴重的錯誤。

items.exampleEn: Most people now read the news in digital form.
items.exampleZh: 現在大多數人以數位形式閱讀新聞。

items.sentenceEn: My dad bought a new digital camera.
items.sentenceZh: 我爸爸買了一台新的數位相機。

items.audioEn: Because of the severe weather, the roads are closed, and all classes will be online today.
items.audioZh: 因為天候惡劣，道路都封閉了，今天所有課程都改成線上上課。
options: In the school hall, as usual.

items.sentenceEn: The stars are not visible tonight because of the clouds.
items.sentenceZh: 今晚因為雲層，星星看不見。

items.sentenceEn: This is a practical way to save time.
items.sentenceZh: 這是一個節省時間的實用方法。

items.stemEn: Nothing special happened. It was a very ____ day.
items.stemZh: 沒發生什麼特別的事，那是很平凡的一天。

items.stemEn: The tiny bird was hardly ____ in the tall grass.
items.stemZh: 那隻小鳥在高高的草叢裡幾乎看不見。

items.passageEn: Last month, my school held a joint event with a leading technology company. The event was not formal, so students could wear ordinary clothes. The speakers showed us how digital tools can help with schoolwork. Their tips were very practical, like how to keep all your notes in one place. One speaker explained that some problems are not visible at first. For example, a phone can stop working without any warning. His friend once had a severe problem: she lost two years of photos in one day. So he told us to always save copies of important files. I acquired many useful skills that day.
items.passageZh: 上個月，我們學校和一家領先的科技公司合辦了一場活動。活動不是正式的，所以學生可以穿平常的衣服。講者向我們示範數位工具可以怎麼幫助完成課業。他們的建議非常實用，像是怎麼把所有筆記放在同一個地方。有一位講者說明，有些問題一開始是看不見的。例如，手機可能毫無預警就壞掉。他的朋友曾經遇到一個嚴重的問題：她在一天之內弄丟了兩年的照片。所以他要我們一定要把重要的檔案存備份。那天我學到了許多實用的技能。

questions.questionZh: 學生那天為什麼可以穿平常的衣服？
options: 因為學校規定週五穿便服
因為那場活動不是正式的場合

questions.questionZh: 講者的朋友遇到了什麼問題？
options: 手機被偷走後一直找不回來
電腦中毒，所有作業都消失了
不小心把檔案寄給陌生人

items.promptZh: 這是我們兩班的聯合演出。
referenceEn: This is a joint show of our two classes.
This is a joint performance by our two classes.
rubricZh: joint 表示「共同的、聯合的」，例如 a joint show 等說法
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式等）

items.instructionZh: 用 practical 造一個句子，說說一個你覺得實用的東西或方法。
referenceEn: A small bag is very practical for going to class.
I think learning to cook is a practical skill.
rubricZh: practical 表示「實用的」，例如 a practical skill 等說法
說的是自己的看法（例如 I think）
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式等）
